name: Safe Steps
summary:
Safe Steps is a Virtual Reality application designed to teach Indian school-going children essential traffic and road-safety practices through immersive, interactive experiences. It helps children understand safe road crossing, traffic signals, pedestrian etiquette, hazard awareness, and responsible behavior in realistic virtual road environments.
